top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 chain from proglucagon processing and incretin physiology through the active GLP-1(7-36/37) peptide to agonists with large, trial-confirmed benefits in glycaemia, body weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes is mature and complete. The Drucker, Holst and Mojsov allocation fits the three-person cap and a discovery-centred citation; the unresolved Mojsov/Habener priority question lowers confidence but does not justify no award.
